title: Remove Tote via Hospital HMI (shortcut to Remove Tote screen)
summary: Use the Hospital HMI Add Tote screen controls (green scanner, Tote ID and Barcode fields, and CONFIRM & EXECUTE) to send a tote back into the OptiSweep system from the induct side. Use the 1.2 Remove Tote button as a shortcut to the Remove Tote screen.
when_to_use: When a tote needs to be sent back into the OptiSweep system from the hospital station induct side using the Hospital HMI workflow.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate the Hospital HMI screens, scan the tote barcode(s) with the green scanner, verify induct-side WCS position information, and press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to send the tote back into the system.
access_or_tools_needed: Hospital HMI access to the Add Tote screen and the Remove Tote screen (via the 1.2 Remove Tote shortcut button).
Green scanner for tote bar code scanning.

system_preconditions: A tote is positioned properly on the induct side of the hospital station (flush against the end stops on the induct side).

visual_references.description: Hospital HMI Add Tote screen showing green scanner inputs for Tote ID and Barcode, CONFIRM & EXECUTE, Induct Position Information panel, and the 1.2 Remove Tote shortcut button.
Hospital HMI Remove Tote screen showing green scanner inputs for Tote ID and Barcode, CONFIRM & EXECUTE, Extract Position Information panel, and the 1.1 Add Tote shortcut button.
Hospital Station layout diagram showing induct side (left side) and end stops to ensure the tote is flush for inducting back into the system.

steps.title: Open the Hospital HMI screen with the "1.2 Remove Tote" shortcut button
steps.purpose: Get to the correct Hospital HMI workflow entry point for the Remove Tote screen shortcut.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI, open the screen that contains the "1.2 Remove Tote" shortcut button (shown on the Hospital HMI Add Tote screen).
steps.expected_result: The Hospital HMI screen is displayed with a visible "1.2 Remove Tote" shortcut button.
steps.healthy_condition: "1.2 Remove Tote" shortcut button is visible on the Hospital HMI Add Tote screen.
steps.failure_condition: The "1.2 Remove Tote" shortcut button is not visible (wrong screen/workflow).

actions.label: Open Add Tote screen
actions.exact_action: Open the Hospital HMI screen that contains the "1.2 Remove Tote" shortcut button (shown on the Hospital HMI Add Tote screen).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Hospital HMI "Add Tote" screen includes: "1.2 Remove Tote Button A shortcut button to the \"Remove Tote\" screen." (Figure 4-31).

steps.title: Navigate to the "Remove Tote" screen using the "1.2 Remove Tote" shortcut
steps.purpose: Reach the Remove Tote screen workflow for tote removal/send-back actions.
steps.instruction: Press the "1.2 Remove Tote" button to navigate to the "Remove Tote" screen.
steps.expected_result: The Hospital HMI "Remove Tote" screen is displayed.
steps.healthy_condition: "Remove Tote" screen header/workflow is shown (Figure 4-32) with Tote ID and Barcode scan controls and CONFIRM & EXECUTE.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing the shortcut does not change screens (still on Add Tote screen) or the Remove Tote workflow is not displayed.

actions.label: Press Remove Tote shortcut
actions.exact_action: Press the "1.2 Remove Tote" button to navigate to the "Remove Tote" screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "1.2 Remove Tote Button A shortcut button to the \"Remove Tote\" screen."
Figure 4-32: Hospital HMI Remove Tote Screen ("1.2 REMOVE TOTE").

steps.title: Scan tote barcode to populate the "Tote ID" field
steps.purpose: Enter the correct tote identifier for the send-back/remove workflow.
steps.instruction: On the Remove Tote screen, use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code to populate the "Tote ID" field.
steps.expected_result: The "Tote ID" field is populated after scanning with the green scanner.
steps.healthy_condition: "Tote ID" field shows a value corresponding to the scanned tote bar code.
steps.failure_condition: "Tote ID" field does not populate after scanning.

actions.label: Scan Tote ID
actions.exact_action: Use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code to populate with the tote ID.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Remove Tote screen: "Tote ID Use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code to populate with the tote ID." (Figure 4-32).

steps.title: Scan tote barcode to populate the "Barcode" field
steps.purpose: Enter the tote barcode value required by the workflow.
steps.instruction: Press the "Barcode" control (press and then use the green scanner) and scan the tote bar code to populate the "Barcode" field.
steps.healthy_condition: "Barcode" field shows the scanned barcode value.
steps.failure_condition: "Barcode" field does not populate after scanning.

actions.label: Scan Barcode
actions.exact_action: Press and then use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Remove Tote screen: "Barcode Press and then use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code." (Figure 4-32).

steps.title: Verify induct-side WCS position information and Status before executing
steps.purpose: Ensure the tote is positioned properly on the induct side and that WCS has received the expected induct-side data before sending/confirming execution.
steps.instruction: Verify the "Induct Position Information" panel shows WCS data for the induct side, including AGV#, Tote ID (induct side), Barcode, and that a "Status" message is present.
steps.expected_result: "Induct Position Information" panel displays AGV#, Tote ID (induct side), Barcode, and a "Status" message.
steps.healthy_condition: Induct Position Information panel contains WCS-received values (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode) and a Status message indicating the tote is ready for the next action.
steps.failure_condition: Induct Position Information panel does not show expected WCS data (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status).

actions.label: Check Induct Position Information
actions.exact_action: Verify the "Induct Position Information" panel shows WCS data for the induct side, including AGV#, Tote ID (induct side), and that a "Status" message is present.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the "Induct Position Information" panel does not show expected WCS data (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status), do not execute; re-check that the tote is positioned properly on the induct side before pressing "CONFIRM & EXECUTE".

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Add Tote screen: "Induct Position Information This is information received from the WCS. l AGV#: ... l Tote ID: ... l Barcode: ... l Status: Status messages received from the WCS about the tote." (Figure 4-31).
Hospital Station Operation: If a tote is going back into the system, put the tote on the induct side (left side) of the station and ensure the tote is flush against the end stops.

steps.title: Press "CONFIRM & EXECUTE" to send the tote back into the system
steps.purpose: Trigger the system action to send the tote back into the OptiSweep system after induct-side positioning and WCS data verification.
steps.instruction: After the tote is positioned properly on the induct side and the Induct Position Information panel shows WCS data and Status, press "CONFIRM & EXECUTE" to send the tote back into the system.
steps.expected_result: The tote is sent back into the system via the induct side after pressing "CONFIRM & EXECUTE".
steps.healthy_condition: CONFIRM & EXECUTE is pressed only when induct-side WCS data (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status) is present; the workflow completes without needing re-entry due to missing/incorrect scan data.
steps.failure_condition: CONFIRM & EXECUTE is pressed when induct-side WCS data is missing/incorrect, or the tote does not proceed as expected (operator must re-check positioning and scan inputs).

actions.label: Confirm & Execute
actions.exact_action: After the tote is positioned properly on the induct side, press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to send the tote back into the system.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the "Tote ID" and/or "Barcode" fields do not populate after scanning with the green scanner, re-scan the tote bar code.

If the "Induct Position Information" panel does not show expected WCS data (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status), do not execute; re-check that the tote is positioned properly on the induct side before pressing "CONFIRM & EXECUTE".

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Add Tote screen: "Confirm & Execute Button After the tote is positioned properly on the induct side, press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to send the tote back into the system." (Figure 4-31).

success_criteria: After pressing "CONFIRM & EXECUTE", the tote is sent back into the system via the induct side.
The Hospital HMI "Induct Position Information" panel reflects WCS-received information including AGV#, Tote ID (induct side), Barcode, and a Status message.
healthy_conditions: Tote ID field populates after scanning with the green scanner.
Barcode field populates after pressing Barcode and scanning with the green scanner.
Induct Position Information panel shows WCS data for the induct side: AGV#, Tote ID (induct side), Barcode, and Status message.
failure_conditions: Tote ID and/or Barcode fields do not populate after scanning.
Induct Position Information panel does not show expected WCS data (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status).
CONFIRM & EXECUTE is attempted without proper induct-side positioning and/or without WCS data present.
escalation_guidance: If the Induct Position Information panel does not show expected WCS data (AGV#, Tote ID, Barcode, Status) and re-scanning/re-positioning does not resolve it, stop and escalate to the appropriate support team/site lead for further troubleshooting.
